pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition of scaling into consecutive failing orders within a 60-second window; maximum 1 primary position per identified order block until price confirms structural continuation.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Zero entry allowed within 15 minutes of high-impact tier-1 USD macro releases; execution requires a minimum 3-point ATR confirmation candle close past the local breakout level.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing stop activation or partial scale-out once unrealized profit hits +$5.00 to prevent floating gains from evaporating into commissions and slippage.
